source.note: Transcribed from the kitchen's Arabic text (bakery, café drinks, ice cream). "---" in the original file only marks where one pasted block ends. Checked by two independent blind transcriptions per section, four reviewers and three judges.

conventions.units: g, ml or pc only. Every qty is in its ingredient's unit.
conventions.ids: ingredients[].id and subRecipes[].id are fixed: uuid5(uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "https://touch-padel.com/stock/ingredients"), key), so a later migration can recompute an id from its key without a name lookup. menu.variant_id is the size's id from seeds/touch-cafe-menu.sql, checked against the live menu on 2026-09-25.
conventions.subRecipes: Batch-made items become PREPARED ingredients. lines[].qty is for one whole batch as the kitchen wrote it; lines[].perUnit = qty / batchYield rounded to 3 decimals, which is what recipe_lines stores for the batch item. A sale takes the batch item from its own stock, so each batch must be recorded as made (only a head chef, chef, manager or owner can) or the sale overdraws and raises a negative-stock alert. active=false items are not on the menu and cannot be recorded as made.
conventions.menuRecipes: One recipe per menu item size (menu.variant). A size carries one set of lines; add-ons can carry their own lines, added per add-on picked.
conventions.status: ready = loaded by migration 20260925000190. incomplete = a line has no number or no confirmed ingredient (see its missing question), or batchYield is unknown (yieldMissing), or it waits on blockedBy. needs-decision = hot and iced differ; see Q04.
conventions.unitInferred: true where the kitchen wrote a number with no unit and the unit was taken from the ingredient (grams for dry goods and fruit, ml for liquids).
conventions.notTracked: Water and ice are not stock (Q30); they are kept per recipe so nothing written is lost.
conventions.goLive: Owner decision 2026-09-25: ingredients and every ready recipe load together. A menu item with a recipe shows as blocked by stock at the till and greyed on the website while a bought ingredient it uses has 0 on hand. A batch-made item at 0 is looked through to its own ingredients, so desserts and ice-cream drinks become sellable once the raws are in even with no batch recorded; record a batch before service or those sales overdraw the batch item at no cost. Opening stock goes in through Receive delivery with a real unit cost on every line, not through a stock count. A sale's cost is fixed when the line is added to the order: a line added before its ingredients have a cost records 0, and that is not corrected later. Receive nothing for passion fruit, coconut, peanuts or liquid cream until Q06, Q28 and Q17 are answered: the first delivery fixes an ingredient's unit.
conventions.notIncluded: Pack size, pack cost, supplier, shelf life, par and low-stock levels were not in the text; they are entered on the Ingredients page and at goods-in.

questions.en: The six lattes are made differently hot and iced (hot: single shot, 150–180 ml milk, 20 ml sauce; iced: double shot, 180–200 ml milk, 25 ml sauce). The till does not record whether a latte was served hot or iced, so it cannot tell which recipe to use. (a) Split each latte into two sizes, Hot and Iced, at the same price; the cashier picks one on every latte, like Single/Double on Espresso. (b) Use the hot recipe for both; every iced latte is then under-counted by 8 g beans, 20–30 ml milk and 5 ml sauce. (c) Keep the hot recipe on the size and add a free "Iced" add-on the cashier ticks, carrying those extra amounts; this takes six separate Iced add-ons, one per latte, because an add-on carries the same amounts on every item it is linked to and the extra milk and sauce differ from latte to latte. Until you choose, the lattes use no stock. Hibiscus Tea joins this choice if Q03 says the two كجرات batches are its hot and iced versions, and Flat White if Q32 says iced differs.

Is that right? For Banana, Snickers, Kit Kat, Kinder and Oreo: what exactly goes in (a sauce, real banana, or the chocolate bar or biscuits), and how much? Are mocha sauce and chocolate sauce the same bottle? Is the strawberry smoothie sauce the same as the milkshake one?
questions.ar: الصوصات: مكتوب "صوص 35" لكل الميلك شيك والفرابتشينو و "30 مل صوص" للسموذي. احنا حطينا: فراولة ← صوص فراولة، لوتس ← صوص لوتس، بستاشيو ← صوص بستاشيو، شوكولا ← صوص شوكولا، كراميل ← صوص كراميل، شوكولا بيضاء ← صوص شوكولا بيضاء، وكل سموذي صوصه من نفس نوعه (خوخ ← صوص خوخ، منكا ← صوص منكا، أناناس ← صوص أناناس، فراولة ← صوص فراولة). صحيح؟ والموز والسنيكرز والكت كات والكندر والأوريو: شنو ينحط بالضبط؟ صوص، لو موز طبيعي، لو الشوكولاتة أو البسكويت نفسه؟ وكم؟ وصوص الموكا نفس صوص الشوكولا؟ وصوص الفراولة مال السموذي نفسه مال الميلك شيك؟

questions.en: Turkish coffee: your line is "تركيه + بندق 30 غرام + فنجان ونص ماء". Is 30 g the coffee for one order? (A cup usually takes 7–10 g.) Is it the same for plain, medium and hazelnut? For hazelnut, do you use a separate hazelnut coffee, or the same coffee with hazelnut added, and how much?
questions.ar: القهوة التركية: مكتوب "تركيه + بندق 30 غرام + فنجان ونص ماء". الـ 30 غرام هي البن للطلب الواحد؟ (العادة 7 إلى 10 غرام للفنجان). ونفس الكمية للسادة والوسط والبندق؟ والبندق: قهوة بندق خاصة، لو نفس القهوة وتضيفون عليها بندق؟ وكم؟

questions.en: Karak and lemon tea: what is the 30 g? A ready powder or mix, or tea leaves?
questions.ar: شاي الكرك وشاي الليمون: الـ 30 غرام شنو بالضبط؟ باودر جاهز لو خلطة لو ورق شاي؟

questions.en: Ice cream yield: one batch is taken to make 2000 g (vanilla) and 2075 g (chocolate), the weight of what goes in. Weigh one finished batch to confirm.
questions.ar: الآيس كريم: حسبنا الخلطة تطلع 2000 غرام فانيلا و 2075 غرام شوكولا (يعني وزن اللي ينحط بيها: الماي والباودر والصوص). ممكن توزنون خلطة وحدة بعد ما تجهز حتى نتأكد؟

questions.en: Units: "15 فول سوداني" is taken as 15 g (not 15 peanuts), "جوز الهند 5" as 5 g, and "1:5 جزر" as 1.5 carrots. Right? What form is the coconut: flakes, powder, or a coconut syrup or milk (then ml)?
questions.ar: الوحدات: 15 فول سوداني يعني 15 غرام (مو 15 حبة)؟ جوز الهند 5 يعني 5 غرام؟ و "1:5 جزر" يعني جزرة ونص؟ وجوز الهند شنو بالضبط: مبشور، باودر، لو سيروب أو حليب جوز هند (يعني بالمل)؟

questions.en: Anything missing? Rainbow has no colouring or oil, Milk cake has no milk soak, Cookies have no chocolate chips, and Donut has no frying oil or topping.
questions.ar: أكو شي ناقص بالوصفات؟ الرينبو بدون ألوان ولا زيت، كيك الحليب بدون خلطة الحليب اللي تنسقى بيها الكيكة، الكوكيز بدون حبيبات شوكولا، والدونات بدون زيت قلي ولا تغطية.

questions.en: Water and ice are left out of stock (they are not bought). Say if the café buys ice or bottled water and wants it counted.

The Red Bull mojito (a whole can instead of 1.5 Sprite) cannot be counted yet, because the till would count Sprite. It needs its own menu item, or a Sprite / Red Bull choice on the mojitos where each choice carries its own can.
Flat White is sold hot and iced; only one recipe was given. Is iced the same?
questions.ar: الفلات وايت ينباع حار وبارد، ووصلتنا وصفة وحدة بس. البارد نفس الوصفة؟

questions.en: Who makes the ice cream mix and fills the machine: the bar or the kitchen chefs? Only a head chef, chef, manager or owner can record a batch in the app, and every milkshake takes its ice cream from recorded batches.
questions.ar: منو يسوي خلطة الآيس كريم ويعبي المكينة: البار لو الشيفات بالمطبخ؟ (بالبرنامج بس رئيس الطهاة أو مساعد الشيف أو المدير أو المالك يكدر يسجل الخلطة، وكل ميلك شيك ياخذ الآيس كريم مالته من الخلطات المسجلة)

questions.en: No recipe came for these menu items: Mixed smoothie, Iraqi Tea, Watermelon juice, Piña Colada, Immunity Shot, Protein, Hot Chocolate, Iced Chocolate, V60 and Cold Brew. Please send them.
questions.ar: هذني موجودة بالمنيو بس ما وصلتنا وصفاتهم: سموذي مكس، شاي عراقي، عصير بطيخ، بينا كولادا، شوت المناعة، بروتين، شوكولاتة ساخنة، شوكولاتة مثلجة، V60، كولد برو. ممكن تدزولنا وصفاتهم؟
